description: This file is a Java test class named RootRouteTest that contains unit tests for the RootRoute class in a web service application. It verifies routing and security behaviors of various API endpoints, including health, status, things, and websocket routes.

classes.name: RootRouteTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class for testing the routing and security of the RootRoute in a web service API. It covers various endpoints including health, status, things, and websocket, with different authentication scenarios.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, setting up the route with mock dependencies and configuration before each test.

methods.name: getRoot
methods.description: Tests that a GET request to the root path '/' results in a 404 NOT_FOUND status.

methods.name: getHealthWithoutAuthReturnsOK
methods.description: Verifies that accessing the health endpoint without authentication returns a 200 OK.

methods.name: getStatusWithAuth
methods.description: Tests that an authenticated request to the overall status endpoint returns a success status.

methods.name: getStatusWithoutAuth
methods.description: Ensures that an unauthenticated request to the status endpoint results in UNAUTHORIZED.

methods.name: getStatusUrlWithoutHttps
methods.description: Checks that accessing the status URL without HTTPS results in a NOT_FOUND response.

methods.name: getStatusHealth
methods.description: Verifies the response of the /status/health endpoint, expecting a success code.

methods.name: getStatusHealthWithoutHttps
methods.description: Checks that the /status/health endpoint is inaccessible without HTTPS, returning NOT_FOUND.

methods.name: getStatusCluster
methods.description: Verifies the /status/cluster endpoint responds successfully when accessed properly.

methods.name: getStatusClusterWithoutHttps
methods.description: Ensures /status/cluster is not accessible without HTTPS.

methods.name: getThingWithVeryLongId
methods.description: Tests that requesting a thing with an excessively long ID returns a BAD_REQUEST with the appropriate exception payload.

methods.name: getThingsUrlWithoutIds
methods.description: Checks that requesting things without IDs results in BAD_REQUEST.

methods.name: getThingsUrlWithIds
methods.description: Tests successful retrieval of things when providing valid IDs.

methods.name: getThings1UrlWithoutHttps
methods.description: Verifies that /things endpoint is not accessible without HTTPS.

methods.name: getThings2UrlWithoutHttps
methods.description: Verifies that version 2 /things endpoint is not accessible without HTTPS.

methods.name: getThingsUrlWithIdsWithWrongVersionNumber
methods.description: Checks that an invalid version number in the URL results in NOT_FOUND.

methods.name: getThingsUrlWithIdsWithNonExistingVersionNumber
methods.description: Checks that a non-existent version number returns NOT_FOUND.

methods.name: getThingWithResponseRequiredFalse
methods.description: Verifies that setting 'response-required=false' returns a BAD_REQUEST with a specific exception message.

methods.name: getThingSearchUrl
methods.description: Tests successful retrieval of lookups via the thing search endpoint.

methods.name: getWhoamiUrl
methods.description: Verifies that the /whoami endpoint responds successfully.

methods.name: getNonExistingSearchUrl
methods.description: Checks that an unknown search URL returns NOT_FOUND.

methods.name: getWsUrlWithoutUpgrade
methods.description: Ensures that a WebSocket request without an upgrade header does not upgrade.

methods.name: getWsUrlWithoutHttps
methods.description: Verifies WebSocket endpoint is not accessible without HTTPS.

methods.name: getNonExistingToplevelUrl
methods.description: Checks that accessing an unknown top-level URL returns NOT_FOUND.

methods.name: getNonExistingToplevelUrlWithoutHttps
methods.description: Verifies that unknown top-level URL redirects with a MOVED_PERMANENTLY to HTTPS URL.

methods.name: getExceptionForDuplicateHeaderFields
methods.description: Tests that duplicate headers result in BAD_REQUEST with appropriate error payload.

methods.name: getExceptionForDuplicationHeaderAndQueryParameter
methods.description: Checks that providing summary header and query parameter with different values returns BAD_REQUEST with specific error message.

methods.name: getExceptionDueToTooManyAuthSubjects
methods.description: Verifies that exceeding the maximum number of auth subjects returns REQUEST_HEADER_FIELDS_TOO_LARGE.

methods.name: acceptMaximumNumberOfAuthSubjects
methods.description: Verifies that the maximum allowed number of auth subjects is accepted with an OK status.

methods.name: getExceptionDueToLargeHeaders
methods.description: Tests that headers exceeding size limit trigger REQUEST_HEADER_FIELDS_TOO_LARGE.

methods.name: getExceptionDueToInvalidHeaderKey
methods.description: Checks that invalid header keys throw an exception.

methods.name: getExceptionDueToInvalidHeaderValue
methods.description: Checks that invalid header values throw an exception.

methods.name: withHttps
methods.description: Helper method to add HTTPS forwarding header to a request.

methods.name: withPreAuthenticatedAuthentication
methods.description: Helper method to add a pre-authentication header with a given subject.
